name: HudsonOS
tagline: This website. A personal site disguised as a Windows XP desktop.
description: A window manager, taskbar, start menu, boot screen and theme engine written from scratch in vanilla JavaScript — no frameworks, no build step.
Every app on the desktop is a small module that renders from JSON, so the whole site is content-editable without touching code.
